name: trustlayer-monorepo
description: TrustLayer — Access-Aware RAG Gateway & Policy Firewall

scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run uvicorn trustlayer.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.dev: npm run build && cd backend && uv run uvicorn trustlayer.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.start: cd backend && uv run uvicorn trustlayer.main:app --port 8000
scripts.test:backend: cd backend && uv run pytest src/trustlayer/test_safety_fixes.py -v
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run build
